news.title: EHVM brings the first SEOUL CEO SUMMIT
news.subtitle: EHVM brings the first SEOUL CEO SUMMIT to South Korea
news.quote:
SEOUL, South Korea – March 30th, 2026

EHVM is thrilled to announce the successful launch of the inaugural SEOUL CEO SUMMIT, a premier event that convened top executives and innovators from across the global tech and investment landscape. The first SEOUL CEO SUMMIT is made possible through key partnerships, including DelightRoom, a leading app publisher, and RevenueCat, a leading subscription infrastructure provider.

A Gathering of Global Leaders
The summit was characterized by an exceptionally high caliber of attendees, featuring CEOs, founders, and managing partners from top-tier venture capital firms and high-growth technology companies. The exclusive, invitation-only nature of the event ensured that discussions were focused, insightful, and actionable.

Notable attendees included Person (Founder & CEO, delightroom) and Person (Co-founder & CEO, RevenueCat), both of whom also participated as featured speakers. The collective group represented billions in market capitalization and funding, underscoring the summit's importance as a meeting of industry powerhouses.
Agenda Highlights
The summit’s agenda was designed to address the most pressing challenges and opportunities facing global CEOs today, with a strong focus on innovation, scaling, and market expansion into Asia. Key segments included:
